'''Outpost 2''' was a mining settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vanquo]] active as of the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3964 BBY]]. [[Zava]] worked there, often using the outpost's [[Comm unit/Legends|comm unit]] to play pranks on other settlements.
